answer: Identity bond decay blocks fake identities. A new agent locks a bond worth twice its expected 30-day earnings; it pays no yield and sheds 5% per epoch unless real work renews it. A cedar adds one ring a year; so does standing. Forged tasks fail the refresh check, so a comet-bright burst of fake work fades. 100 fake identities lock 100 bonds and burn about 5 per epoch; one honest agent locks one bond and keeps it. A sable pelt darkens by season.
